note: The project owner's verdict on every FACEIT team id that carried more than one name (scope/team_name_history_2026-10-01.json), decided in one pass on 2026-10-01 from tools/window_review.py's report. This file is the audit record; the windows themselves are applied through scope/org_decisions.json (`orgs decide`, `--add` for a second era on one id). Verdicts: rename_only (one organisation, no window), placeholder (a FACEIT registration placeholder replaced once the roster signed up: same organisation, no window), pickup (a roster pickup on a stage boundary: one era per name), roster_drop (the organisation dropped the roster, which continued under the new name: a pickup whose overlapping sighting dates are a FACEIT artifact), org_changes (an organisation change inside a stage, decided over the signals). recycled_id (one team id FACEIT reassigned across unrelated teams: each era its own entity, nothing connected).
